import hashlib,json,platform
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import scipy
from scipy.stats import binom,binomtest

alpha=0.05
null_fpr=0.01
sizes=np.arange(1,10001)
raw_cutoff=binom.ppf(alpha,sizes,null_fpr).astype(int)
cutoffs=raw_cutoff-(binom.cdf(raw_cutoff,sizes,null_fpr)>alpha)
rows=[]
for actual_fpr in (0.001,0.005):
 power=binom.cdf(cutoffs,sizes,actual_fpr)
 for desired in (0.8,0.9):
  index=int(np.flatnonzero(power>=desired)[0])
  n=int(sizes[index]);k=int(cutoffs[index])
  assert binomtest(k,n,null_fpr,alternative='less').pvalue<=alpha
  assert binomtest(k+1,n,null_fpr,alternative='less').pvalue>alpha
  assert not any(power[:index]>=desired)
  rows.append({'assumed_true_fpr':actual_fpr,'desired_power':desired,'independent_groups':n,
               'maximum_false_positives':k,'null_rejection_probability':float(binom.cdf(k,n,null_fpr)),
               'conditional_power':float(power[index])})
record={'schema_id':'hallmark/admission-power-scenarios/1','date':'2026-10-20',
        'evidence_class':'conditional-statistical-calculation','approved_design':False,
        'alpha':alpha,'null_fpr':null_fpr,'search_upper_groups':10000,'rows':rows,
        'zero_event_299':{'upper_bound':1-alpha**(1/299),
                          'power_if_true_fpr_0_001':float(binom.cdf(0,299,0.001)),
                          'power_if_true_fpr_0_005':float(binom.cdf(0,299,0.005))},
        'assumptions':['independent identically distributed Bernoulli root groups',
                       'one preselected representative per group',
                       'one prespecified model and one primary one-sided test',
                       'no slice/multiple-comparison correction in these scenarios'],
        'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'environment':{'python':platform.python_version(),'scipy':scipy.__version__,'numpy':np.__version__}}
Path('research/evidence/w13-power-scenarios-2026-10-20.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k not in ['source','source_sha256','environment']},indent=2))
